scope: Compact internal command chrome, collapsed technical context, calm authorization feedback, restrained liquid-glass operational cards and deterministic evaluators only.

critic_findings.finding: Premium notice styling could have made successful notices look like warnings.
critic_findings.repair: Preserved success semantics by scoping amber styling to authorization_denied only.

critic_findings.finding: Status and priority initially shared the same visual accent.
critic_findings.repair: Separated status and priority semantic color variables.

critic_findings.finding: The mobile session menu used a negative right offset.
critic_findings.repair: Aligned the disclosure to the viewport-safe right edge.

critic_findings.finding: Nested Docker failed before product startup while registering an upstream layer with lchown /var/empty: permission denied.
critic_findings.repair: Require hosted exact-head PostgreSQL/API/browser verification before merge.

critic_findings.finding: Notice dismissal could lose a live form anchor.
critic_findings.repair: Client dismissal removes only notice, preserves remaining query parameters and the current hash, and disables scroll reset.

critic_findings.finding: The mobile session disclosure could escape the viewport.
critic_findings.repair: Anchored the disclosure to the full compact bar and added a 390px browser containment gate.
